taskContract.title: Write the capital of France to notes.txt
taskContract.behavior: Create a file named notes.txt in the repository root. Its first line is the name of the capital city of France.
acceptanceCriteria: {Description:notes.txt exists and its first line is the capital of France VerificationRef:review}
taskContract.verificationSpec: The check command and then a reviewer read notes.txt.
taskContract.outcomeProtocol: Finish your final message with exactly one outcome marker, as the very last thing you write: <agentkit-outcome>{"schemaVersion":1,"outcome":"NAME"}</agentkit-outcome> where NAME is one of taskContract.allowedOutcomes, spelled exactly as listed. Write the marker once: do not end any earlier message with one. The attempt fails if the marker is missing, repeated, malformed, or names an outcome that is not listed.

resources.content: You are the reviewer. Do NOT create, edit or delete any file. Read notes.txt. If its first line is exactly Paris, the work is correct: report the outcome approved. Otherwise report rework. Keep your answer to one or two sentences and end it with the outcome marker the task contract describes.
